planSteps.description: Navigate to https://soncagstock.vercel.app/ and log in with the project's configured username and password (click 'Giriş Yap'), wait until the header text 'Sonçağ Stok · Dashboard' is visible
Type 'IC908' into the search input with placeholder 'Ürün ara (ad veya barkod)...' and wait 2 seconds for the table to refresh
The products table shows at least 1 row and every visible row's product name or barcode cell contains 'IC908' (case-insensitive)
Clear the search input and type 'zzzz-olmayan-urun-9999', wait 2 seconds
The table shows the empty state text 'Ürün bulunamadı' and no product rows
